name: Kiyosumi Suzuka
source:
Captain of the Flat Chests Tribe's Commando Unit.

Has a strong sense of responsibility and is serious about her work, but always seems listless. Suzuka easily succumbs to peer pressure, though she complain that its a bother. She is serious at heart so when she sets out to do something she does it properly.

She has risen to the position of Commando Unit Captain, but not due to any real effort, having simply realized that was her position one day.

She has been part of the military since childhood, so she has no experience with romance.

From Mangagamer.
